name: FlowMM
one_liner: Riemannian flow matching on crystal flat tori and symmetric lattice manifolds with stability computed by CHGNet and DFT relaxations on generated samples.

loop.proposes: A Riemannian flow-matching network integrates geodesic vector fields on the periodic torus of fractional coordinates and SPD lattice representations.
loop.judged_by: Symmetry-aware structural matchers, CHGNet force-field relaxations, and VASP DFT calculations evaluate thermodynamic stability (E_hull) on generated samples.
loop.steers: DFT and CHGNet relaxations compute stability metrics on generated samples; the flow is trained on a fixed dataset.

headline_result: Achieved state-of-the-art thermodynamic stability and 3x faster integration steps than diffusion baselines on MP-20 and MPTS-52.
caveat: Like other crystal generators, requires downstream DFT phonon calculations to confirm dynamic vibrational stability at finite temperature.
beyond_harness_note: Riemannian flow matching on crystal manifolds generates candidate lattices whose stability is computed afterwards with CHGNet and DFT relaxations.
algorithmic_authority: Crystallographic manifold constraints and VASP DFT evaluator

sources.title: FlowMM: Generating Materials with Riemannian Flow Matching (ICML 2024 / arXiv:2406.04713)

verification.notes: Checked against Miller et al., ICML 2024.
